test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: It is a tropical as well as a subtropical crop. It grows well in hot and humid climate with a temperature of 21°C to 27°C and an annual rainfall between 75 cm. and 100 cm. Which of the crop is being talked about in the information given above?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sugarcane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sugarcane**

 
 
• It is a member of the grass family** Poaceae**.
 
• Sugarcane is a **perennial plant**.
 
• Sugarcane is a major source of sugar, and it is also used to make **ethanol, paper, **and **other products**.
 
• Sugarcane is a **tropical plant**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton**

 
 
• Cotton is the most important **natural fiber **in the world.
 
• Cotton is used to make a wide variety of products, including** clothing, home textiles, **and **industrial products**.
 
• Cotton plants are annual plants, and they grow best in warm, sunny climates with **well-drained soil**.
 
 
 
• **Maize** 
 
 
• Maize is a cereal grain that is native to the** Americas**.
 
• Maize is a** staple food** for millions of people.
 
• Maize is a versatile crop that can be used to make a variety of products, including **food, feed, fuel, **and** bioethanol**.
 
 
 
• **Rubber**
 
 
• ​Rubber is a natural or** synthetic polymer**.
 
• Natural rubber is produced from the sap of rubber trees.
 
• Synthetic rubber is made from **petroleum products**.
 
• Rubber has a number of properties that make it a **valuable material**.
